abstract: The nuclear DNA contents of labeled and unlabeled nuclei of trophoblastic cells of 8 normal pregnancies, 2 missed abortions, and 14 cases of trophoblastic diseases were measured by Feulgen-DNA cytofluorometry combined with autoradiography. Syncytiotroblasts were rarely labeled and were considered to be inactive with regard to cell proliferation. Most of the labeled cells were cytotrophoblasts. The predominantly labeled cells ranged between 2 and 4C in cases of normal pregnancy and missed abortion, and a shift to a higher ploidy was seen in the more grave trophoblastic disease. From the point of cellular proliferation kinetics of trophoblastic cells, it is presumed that the cells in cases of normal pregnancy and type I hydatidiform mole are in the 2C cell cycle and in type II hydatidiform mole and in invasive mole there are heterogeneous cell populations, most of which are in the 2C cell cycle while the remaining are undergoing polyploidization or aneuploidization. In choriocarcinoma, the cells are not in the 2C cell cycle and also are probably undergoing polyploidization or aneuploidization in the hyper-4C area.
abstract_ja: 正常妊娠8例、稽留流産2例、および栄養膜疾患14例の栄養膜細胞の核DNA量を、Feulgen-DNA細胞蛍光測定法とオートラジオグラフィーを併用して測定した。合胞体栄養膜細胞はほとんど標識されず、細胞増殖に関しては不活性と考えられた。標識された細胞の大部分は細胞性栄養膜細胞であった。正常妊娠および稽留流産では標識細胞は2Cから4Cの範囲にあり、重症度の高い栄養膜疾患ではより高倍数性へのシフトが認められた。増殖動態の観点から、正常妊娠およびI型胞状奇胎の細胞は2C細胞周期にあり、II型胞状奇胎および侵入奇胎では不均一な細胞集団が認められ、そのほとんどは2C細胞周期にあるが、残りは倍数体化または異数体化の過程にあると考えられた。絨毛癌では細胞は2C細胞周期になく、おそらく過剰4C領域で倍数体化または異数体化していると考えられた。
